name: sound-provider
title: Sound Provider
description: Turns the sounds on for everything inside it. Every sound is synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API (no audio files); without the provider every component stays silent. The visitor's choice is saved in their browser
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/sound-provider · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/sound-provider.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: turn on sound, sound effects, ui sounds, mute toggle, audio feedback
